arm_comparability.critical_comparability_issue: Arm 5 telemetry provider invocation (ceso_service.load_scenario) resets active_fault to NONE, delivering un-faulted telemetry to Arm 5 while Arms 3 and 4 receive faulted telemetry.

metric_validity.latency_defect: total_elapsed_ms sums subcomponents rather than measuring true end-to-end wall-clock latency
remediation_defects: Verification Scope Reduction (VSR) is hardcoded to 66.7%
Remediation Success Rate (RSR) defaults to 100.0% when zero remediations are executed

blocking_issues.title: Arm 5 Injected Fault Erasure Bug in Telemetry Dispatch
blocking_issues.impact: Arm 5 receives un-faulted healthy state telemetry while Arms 3 and 4 receive faulted telemetry, violating matched-input comparability.
blocking_issues.corrective_action: Modify ceso_service.load_scenario or runner.py to pass fault_type explicitly without clearing active_fault to NONE.

blocking_issues.title: Hardcoded VSR and Default 100% RSR Metric Implementation Flaws
blocking_issues.impact: Falsely reports 66.7% VSR and 100% RSR on dataset-only or non-remediated experiment runs.
blocking_issues.corrective_action: Replace hardcoded VSR with dynamic interface probe ratio, and set RSR status to NOT_APPLICABLE when no remediations are executed.

blocking_issues.title: Total Latency Summation Defect
blocking_issues.impact: Undercounts end-to-end wall-clock latency by summing subcomponents and ignoring serialization/logging overhead.
blocking_issues.corrective_action: Measure total_elapsed_ms using time.perf_counter() end-to-end duration.

blocking_issues.corrective_action: Document method-level behavioral equivalence and update freeze manifest documentation to account for Phase 3 method extension.
